svg.title: Harness Evolution: Selected Research Timeline
svg.desc: Selected works from 2022 to September 2026, grouped by first-submission period and research direction. Unequal time intervals; no performance ranking.
svg.text: From agent loops to recursive self-improvement
Selected research · first-submission dates · full bibliography and reading notes below
